compos.summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a map in the background with several location markers. Overlaid on the map is a prominent message instructing the user to "Select a location to view local menu." There is a button labeled "Okay" below the message, likely to confirm the action or proceed. The top of the screen shows the status bar with various icons indicating notifications, signal strength, battery level, and the current time (10:38). The bottom of the screen has navigation icons, including a back button, a home button, and a recent apps button.
